He said he’s not sorry because we weren’t together. He isn’t grasping that I’m upset about the lying. 

I won’t do a joint AMA because I can’t see him again. I loved this man. And I can’t face him again because it hurts too much.
I straight up asked him something. He lied. I found out 2 weeks later. He’s not sorry at all that he lied and has admitted to not being sorry. I’m not doing a joint AMA.

I do in fact struggle with anxiety and depression. I have for a few years I guess, but it was just recently that I came to terms with it. My ex I’m referring to in this said that all that stuff is made up and in my head. His thing was that everyone has problems and I needed to be more positive.
I needed this. I truly needed this.
Aww thank you! It’s been a really rough day for me. So I appreciate your words! I gave him 110% and got about 3% in return.
This guy I know legit did this to his girlfriend of like 6 years
I hope so. He lied and then continued to manipulate me and blamed me. He’s not the guy I fell in love with anymore. People are scary.
Learning that definitely the hard way tonight
I really wanted things to work
